data.title: Bayshore
data.about:
Make your passion for life come alive by basking in all the wonderful things that an upscale waterfront lifestyle has to offer. At Bayshore by Emaar, the world of tomorrow awaits you as it brings you comfort and convenience that will surpass your highest expectations. 

Situated at the heart of the iconic Dubai Creek Harbour, this lavish luxurious destination boasts an array of awe-inspiring views, exciting activities, and exclusive amenities.

Come home to a sophisticated apartment with panoramic views of the beach and the iconic Dubai Creek Tower right at your doorstep. Plus, the sky is the limit when it comes to enjoyment as you can sail, shop, dine, and have fun in accessible and world-class destinations.

characteristics_module.title: The Lifestyle You’ve Always Dreamt of
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• 300-Metre Beach
  • Beach & Water Sports & Breathtaking Sunset Views
  • Licensed Bars & Restaurants
  • Dining at The Waterfront Vida Hotel & Future Tourism Hub
  • 1, 2 & 3 Bedroom Apartments
  • Direct Access to Creek Beach & Creek Canal
  • 5-Year Free Property Management Services
  • 3 BR Apartment starting from AED 1.8m only
  • Only 5% down payment

location_tile.title: A prime location
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Dreaming of a serene and upscale spot in Dubai where the city meets the beach and you can easily navigate across key destinations? Bayshore offers the best things that life has to offer.

  • Only few steps away from the iconic Creek Tower Bridge
  • 05 minutes from Dubai Creek Tower
  • 05 minutes from a major highway
  • 15 minutes from Dubai International Airport
  • 10 minutes from Burj Khalifa
  • Enjoy the convenience of a dedicated metro station
